posts.zh:
dsh-wallpaper-engine 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。在 DSH 网页界面后方渲染本机 Wallpaper Engine 的 Video/Web 壁纸，支持 iOS 风格液态玻璃效果，并可用滑动条调节模糊、暗化、边框与玻璃强度。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-d6f43e983d14d55baf5d.html
posts.en:
dsh-wallpaper-engine is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Wallpaper Engine backgrounds for the DSH web GUI: renders local Video and Web wallpapers behind the chat with an iOS-style liquid glass effect and adjustable blur, dim, border and glass sliders.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-d6f43e983d14d55baf5d.html
